checks.text: With no holdings the page shows the heading "Stock Portfolio", the text "No holdings yet", and the summary lines "Total Cost: $0.00", "Total Value: $0.00" and "Gain/Loss: $0.00".

Filling the field labelled "Symbol" with "AAPL", the field labelled "Shares" with "10", the field labelled "Purchase Price" with "150.25" and clicking the button "Add holding" adds a row in the holdings table containing "AAPL", "10" and "$1,502.50"; the summary shows "Total Cost: $1,502.50" and "No holdings yet" is gone.
After also adding a holding with Symbol "MSFT", Shares "5" and Purchase Price "300.00", the table shows a row with "MSFT" and "$1,500.00", and the summary shows "Total Cost: $3,002.50".
Clicking "Add holding" with an empty Symbol, or with Shares that is empty, 0 or negative, adds no row and shows the message "Enter a symbol and a share count greater than 0".
Every row in the holdings table has a button named "Delete <symbol>". With holdings AAPL and MSFT, clicking "Delete MSFT" removes that row and the summary shows "Total Cost: $1,502.50".

Selecting "AAPL" in the select labelled "Holding" and typing "160.00" in the field labelled "Current Price", then clicking "Log price", updates the AAPL row to show "Value: $1,600.00" and "Gain/Loss: +$97.50"; the summary shows "Total Value: $1,600.00" and "Gain/Loss: +$97.50".
Clicking the tab "History" shows a line chart with the tooltip "AAPL: $160.00" visible on the last data point, and the text "2 snapshots" below the chart.
Clicking the button "Export CSV" copies the text "Symbol,Shares,Cost,Value,Gain/Loss\nAAPL,10,1502.50,1600.00,97.50" to the clipboard and shows the message "Copied to clipboard".
Reload keeps the holding AAPL with Shares 10 and the logged price snapshot of $160.00; the summary still shows "Total Cost: $1,502.50" and "Total Value: $1,600.00".
